rendering.recommended_scale: Preserve aspect ratio; render nearest neighbor and use whole-number scaling when practical.

instructions: Crop only by frames[id].x/y/w/h on the supplied RGBA PNG. Layout uses 15 horizontal bands and variable-width rectangular cells; do NOT treat it as a global fixed 32px or 64px grid. No sprite labels appear on the artwork. Source gutter mapping is manually reviewed but approximate.

interactives.description: Infernal rail-mounted vertical energy trap. Toggle ON for 1000 ms, OFF for 1000 ms in a 2000 ms loop.
interactives.size_adjustment: Default full-height artwork is a 129px source crop. If a room is taller, preserve top and bottom endcaps and tile or resize only the middle energy/rod section; verify split points in source art.
notes: ON alternatives and OFF alternatives are visual choices, not certified one-to-one animation pairs.
ON and OFF visual elements should share a center anchor even though source crop widths vary.
Enable gameplay collision strictly from ON state, not from pixel appearance.
The OFF open-gap alternative visibly separates emitter and receiver; remaining OFF variants show a dim support shaft.
